text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Towards the end of training that day, Manhattan Cafe got injured,
so I took her to the infirmary, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm so sorry.
My carelessness... caused you so much trouble..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, this is...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No... there seem to be many customers ahead of us, so......

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She says that, but from the looks of it,
the nurse's office is completely empty...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Um... I'm all right, so
let's get back to training...?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...The injury isn't very serious,
either...
choice_data_list: I can't let you push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer...
Thank you... for your concern..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...However, it seems many people
are currently resting in bed...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The bed was empty, but someone she alone could see was likely resting upon it...
choice_data_list: Let's sit and rest until it opens up.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Yes...
If that's the case, there shouldn't be any problem...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, that's right. I brought coffee
to drink after our training session...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I'll go grab it real quick...
choice_data_list: I'll go get it for you!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much....
Then, if you insist... please...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, having shared a cup of coffee with her,
I let her rest quietly in an open bed...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for... understanding...
Well then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then.
A cold wind suddenly swept by...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Ah... Wait, not that person... Don't...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. My injury is still hurting, after all,
so I'll pass on training today..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me. If it's not too much trouble, could you bring me a drink...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...In the meantime............ I will
manage something, so............"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I'll be fine, so... hurry...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was practically shoved out of the room...
Returning with drinks later, I found
she was utterly exhausted...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SNAP)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Looks like they turned off the lights for us...
choice_data_list: You want me to go train, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
And while they were at it, they even cheered me on...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ah, everyone is following along...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...It looks like they're curious
about our training..."
choice_data_list: I've gotta show them my good side.
Gotta show them what I've got.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Let's do our best, even more than usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training, when I checked on the injury,
mysteriously enough,
not a trace of it remained...
